tools.name: getinsights
tools.description: Returns taste-based insights based on the input parameters you provide.

tools.name: analysiscompare
tools.description: Analyze and compare two groups of entities.

tools.name: getaudiences
tools.description: The Find Audiences API retrieves a list of audience IDs that can be used for filtering results and refining targeting in recommendations. You can use the returned audience IDs as values for `signal.demographics.audiences` to filter Insights API query results by specific audiences.

tools.name: getaudience-types
tools.description: The Get Audience Types API returns all available audience type IDs, representing different audience categories. You can use this API to explore audience classifications and refine searches in the Find Audiences API. Including `filter.parents.types` allows you to narrow results by relevant entity types.

tools.name: gettags
tools.description: Search for tags that are supported by the `filter.tags`, `exclude.tags`, and `signal.interests.tags parameters`.

tools.name: gettag-types
tools.description: Returns a list of tag types supported by each entity type. You can leverage this data with the Tags API to filter results by specific tag types.

tools.name: getsearch
tools.description: Search for an entity by name or property.

tools.name: getentities
tools.description: Get entities based on an array of IDs.

tools.name: gettrends-entity
tools.description: Get week-over-week trending data for an individual entity.

tools.name: gettrends-category
tools.description: Get the currently trending entities for a category.
